propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) still import adapters.jira/acli_subprocess for scalar concerns, violating the epic requirement of zero vendor imports in core.
The Backend Protocol is extended with scalar read-only members project (DIG-defaulted), query_project (un-defaulted fail-closed), and assert_env_ready() raising a neutral BackendEnvError.
A neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError is added and the Jira AssigneeNotFoundError subclasses it so apply_handlers catches the neutral base while preserving assignee soft-fail semantics.
The four core modules are rewired through the backend instance or select_backend(load_config()) seam and their vendor imports removed.
A new full-tree ast.walk neutrality gate asserts none of the four modules re-grow an adapters.jira/acli_subprocess import at any nesting depth, since the sites are function-nested lazy imports.
Vendor-shaped diff helpers were deliberately excluded (blocked by plan review as ADR 0035 §(d) violation); only the scalar translation-only surface is in scope, documented in the ADR interface table.
